cluster: Helix 42-node high-heterogeneity cluster (A100 x4, V100 x6, L4 x8, L4x2 x4, T4 x10, T4x2 x6, T4x4 x4), all links 1000 Mbps; artifact_evaluation/high_heterogeneity/config/cluster42.ini
v3_layout: experiments/v3_cluster42/layout, planned by plan.py with the frozen V3 M2 search (multi_any) in 91 s; result 1 -> 4 (shared layers 0-47, four replicas of 48-79). No frozen seed or reference existed for this cluster: the reference is the cheapest legal single-boundary initializer from the frozen initial_states.
helix: Helix artifact ILP layout (layout_llama70b/ilp) with Helix MaxFlow online scheduling, as in fixed_window.run method 'helix'. gurobipy 13.0.3 (pip, restricted license) is needed only at import; the existing layout is loaded, not re-solved.
loads: 2150 offered token/s (Helix artifact MaxFlow load) and 1450 (Helix artifact Swarm load)
smoke: seed 100, 60 s, runner check only; not used for any decision

decision.Q1_v3_vs_helix: At each load, V3 beats Helix if its throughput is higher and its P95 TPOT lower on all three seeds.
decision.Q2_latency: At each load, gated improves latency over full-DAG V3 if P95 TPOT is lower on all three seeds and mean relative throughput >= -0.5% (flat-pool rule of v3_gated_generalization).
decision.Q2_efficiency: At each load, gated is more efficient if GPU-seconds per output token is at least 20% lower than full-DAG V3 on all three seeds.
decision.Q3_counterfactual: At 2150 with the one-request decode doubling off, the efficiency claim stands if gated_off GPU-seconds per output token is at least 20% lower than v3_off on all three seeds; latency under the counterfactual is reported, not judged.
decision.reported_not_decisive: P95 TTFT, completion, backlog, common-completed P95, decode batch statistics, paths used
decision.failures: Failed windows are kept as .failure.json, count as not passing for the questions that need them, and are not rerun to fill the table.
